documentation.range: This species is generally widespread across northern New Guinea (Indonesia and Papua New Guinea). It is absent from the Huon Peninsula, Papua New Guinea. It ranges in elevation from sea level to around 400 m asl.
documentation.population: It is common in suitable habitat and resilient to hunting pressures.
documentation.habitats: This species occurs in primary and secondary tropical lowland forests. It can occur in disturbed areas including abandoned gardens. Females give birth to a single young.
documentation.threats: There are no major threats to this species. It is locally threatened by subsistence hunting for food.
documentation.measures: This species occurs in at least one protected area (Mamberamo) and one wildlife management area.
documentation.rationale: Listed as Least Concern in view of its wide distribution, presumed large population (it is abundant in suitable habitat), occurrence in protected areas, tolerance to habitat modification, lack of major threats, and because it is not thought to be in decline.
